verdict.rationale: Square exposes a Payouts API (square-docs-17) which presumably supports payout schedule and reconciliation data, but the evidence pack gives no detail on schedule controls (e.g., daily/weekly/manual), nor on how payouts break down into constituent charges, fees, and refunds. missing for 10: documentation of payout schedule configuration options, payout entries/line-item breakdown by charge/fee/refund, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of reconciliation accuracy.
